reason: Caught by K-3 batch 13 on CI: once web lib files imported domain context entries, ts-packwerk on CI (no build) resolved them to the source packs and refused the layer, while a local run with the domain built resolved them to dist and passed, because packages/domain/tsconfig.json named rootDir but not outDir. detect fires on that tsconfig on main and stays quiet once outDir names the build output.
